name: Second record now stored
meaning: A socket re-send with no identifier of a treatment stored with one is stored a second time.
consequence: A duplicated insulin or carb record on the site: IOB/COB shown doubled.
basis: BF-225, from #8877 (on dev); fix scope decided 2026-10-31

name: Identifier format
meaning: A placeholder, blank, numeric or over-long identifier is treated as absent instead of as an identity.
consequence: Two apps that both sent the same placeholder no longer collapse into one record; the placeholder value is not stored.

name: Duplicate avoided
meaning: A re-send that carries a stored identifier now finds the stored record instead of adding a second one.

name: Replace becomes merge
meaning: A matched re-send merges into the stored record; fields the client left out are kept. Never for treatments.
consequence: A field a client cleared by leaving it out stays set (profile, food, entries, settings).

name: API v3 client _id refused
meaning: An API v3 create carrying its own _id is refused, so the re-send that follows lands differently.
consequence: Upload refused with 400; the client must drop its _id.

name: Shared identifier pick
meaning: Several stored records share one identifier; the write lands on the P4 pick.
consequence: A different one of the duplicates is updated than before.

name: New profile, identifier dropped
meaning: A profile create that copies a stored identifier but has another startDate is stored as a new profile without the identifier.
consequence: Profile history kept; the copied identifier is not stored.

name: Reply only
meaning: The stored data is the same; only the reply differs.
consequence: Clients that read the reply see a different body or status.

name: Deleted stays deleted
meaning: A re-send by identity of a deleted record is acknowledged and the record stays deleted.
consequence: A treatment deleted on the site is not brought back by an uploader re-sending it.

name: Refused where stored
meaning: An API v3 write with a client _id that 15.0.9 stored is refused.

name: No new record beside a deleted one
meaning: A re-send by identity that 15.0.9 stored as a new record next to the deleted one is acknowledged instead.
consequence: The re-sent record does not reappear.

name: Socket re-send now written
meaning: A socket re-send that 15.0.9 ignored now replaces (treatments) or merges.
consequence: Treatments re-sent over the socket drop fields the client left out.

name: New record beside a deleted one
meaning: A re-send matched only by time, after a delete, is stored as a new record instead of reviving the deleted one.
consequence: The treatment shows again either way, as a new record.

name: Error now answered
meaning: A request that answered 5xx or threw now succeeds.
consequence: The record is now stored where 15.0.9 failed.

name: Error becomes refusal
meaning: A 5xx or thrown error becomes a 4xx refusal.
consequence: The client gets a reason instead of a crash.

name: Temporary Target units
meaning: A Temporary Target is stored labelled mg/dl.
consequence: Units are explicit on the stored record.

name: Socket batches
meaning: Every item of a socket batch is stored and answered in its own slot.
consequence: 15.0.9 could store 1 of 3 distinct treatments; now all are stored.

name: Write path only
meaning: The write takes a different path; nothing stored changes.
